facts.fact_text: The applicant is a journalist.
Hyde Park organised a demonstration on 8 May 2008.
The applicant decided to go on hunger strike because he was unable to trace his brother for two days.
On 10 May 2008 at 10 a.m., the applicant stood outside the Government building in Chișinău's main square.
On 10 May 2008 at 10 a.m., the applicant positioned a placard with the inscription "Hunger strike for rights" outside the Government building in Chișinău's main square.
On 10 May 2008 at 10 a.m., the applicant started a silent protest outside the Government building in Chișinău's main square.
Shortly after the applicant began his silent protest on 10 May 2008, police officers approached him.
At approximately 10.45 a.m. on 10 May 2008, the applicant was approached by two persons wearing plain clothes.
One of the two plain-clothed persons hit the applicant, apparently in the hand holding the camera.
The second plain-clothed police officer appeared to forcefully put an end to the applicant's filming.
Two uniformed police officers approached and apprehended the applicant.
The two uniformed police officers took the applicant to a police van without any resistance from the applicant.
The applicant was detained for forty-eight hours in solitary confinement in a cell without windows.
On 12 May 2008 at 11 a.m., the applicant was taken to the Buiucani District Court.
At the end of the hearing on 12 May 2008, at 3 p.m., the applicant was released.
